verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a real robots.txt at register.dpma.de (HTTP 200) with explicit directives: "Disallow: /" for all agents plus enumerated Allow paths. An agent can therefore learn its read permissions before fetching anything, even though the policy is restrictive. Missing for 10: robots.txt evidence for the main dpma.de site and DEPATISnet hosts, and clarity on whether the Allow paths cover the search surface.
